meta.title: Faceless Content Monetization — automation-ready idea dataset
meta.provenance: Official platform docs (direct fetches) + SIMURG websearch/ground (live, TinyFish, bundled free key) + labeled third-party revenue estimates (faceless.my 2026 RPM data)
meta.disclaimer: Revenue figures are estimates, not guarantees. Platform rules verified 2026-09-27 and subject to change.

ad_revenue_share.premium_pools: 30% of net (Premium) / 60% of net (Premium Lite), distributed by member watch time

entry_thresholds_current.full_monetization: 1000 subs + 4000 qualified watch hours (365d) OR 10M qualified Shorts views (90d)

entry_thresholds_2027_new_creators.full_monetization: 8000 qualified watch hours (365d) OR 20M qualified Shorts views (90d)
entry_thresholds_2027_new_creators.note: does NOT affect creators already in YPP - join before 2027-02-01 to lock old thresholds
entry_thresholds_2027_new_creators.shorts_restructuring: Shorts rev-share requires 10M views/90d from 2027-02-01; below-threshold channels stay in YPP, keep long-form earnings, auto-resume on crossing 10M; new incentive programs (Shopping bonuses, brand-deal incentives, trend boosts)

critical_policy.name: inauthentic content (formerly repetitious content)
critical_policy.rule: repetitive or mass-produced content ineligible for monetization; reused-content policy (commentary, clips, compilations, reactions) unchanged

required_for: real person appears to say/do something they didn't
generates realistic scene that didn't occur
genai_disclosure.impact_of_disclosing: none on audience or monetization eligibility

rpm_benchmarks_third_party.source: faceless.my 2026 RPM data (research base: 90 channels, 350 videos)

bonuses.rewards: performance of reels and photos incl. carousels + single-image
bonuses.rules: 18+, located/tax status Japan-South Korea-US, professional account

content_monetization.express_interest: dashboard > Monetisation tab > Content Monetisation form

in_stream_ads.thresholds: 10000 followers + 600000 total minutes viewed in last 60 days (at least 60000 minutes on Page)

creator_incentive.pay_rate: ~$0.70 per 1000 views reported but NOT officially fixed - compensation depends on video quality/interaction

bilibili.note: original content strongly favored; danmaku engagement drives distribution; Mandarin TTS + localized hooks

ideas.name: Long-form explainer channel (finance/AI/business)
week1_steps: D2-3 three guarded AI scripts -> TTS -> FFmpeg
ideas.compliance: original narrative; disclose realistic AI scenes; vary structure per video

ideas.name: Shorts volume channel (facts/history/science)
ideas.compliance: vary hooks/structure per Short; fan-funding tier unchanged - stack early

ideas.name: Facebook Reels conversion pipeline (transform YouTube output)
week1_steps: D1 Page setup + express interest via dashboard form
ideas.compliance: Reels must be >=10 seconds to earn; Partner Monetization Policies

ideas.name: Instagram theme page (Reels + carousels)
ideas.compliance: hooks in first seconds (official tip); relatable content

ideas.name: Reddit-story clips with original commentary
ideas.compliance: must add original commentary/transformation + credit; never verbatim mass-reposting

ideas.name: Affiliate product-review Shorts
monetization_paths: Amazon Associates (3 sales/180d to stay active)
week1_steps: D1 pick 10 products + join Amazon Associates
ideas.compliance: disclose affiliate relationships; honest assessments only

ideas.name: Digital-product funnel (prompt packs, templates, planners)
week1_steps: D4-7 funnel via faceless Shorts/Reels (ideas 2/4 output)
ideas.compliance: highest margin per unit of effort; pairs with every other idea

ideas.name: Bilibili knowledge channel (Chinese)
week1_steps: D2-4 three knowledge videos (Mandarin TTS; expected_scripts declared to simurg)
ideas.compliance: original content strongly favored; declare expected scripts to simurg (language-agnostic drift guard)

ideas.name: Quiz/trivia interactive Shorts
ideas.compliance: comment-driven engagement boosts distribution (official tip); strong subscribe driver

ideas.name: Facts carousels (static AI images)
ideas.compliance: use as a traffic engine feeding ideas 4/6/7

ideas.name: AI-tools tutorial channel + micro-sponsorships
week1_steps: D1-4 three tutorials (screen recording, faceless, guarded scripts)
D5-7 pitch 20 AI-tool companies for $50-200 integrations
ideas.compliance: sponsorships need no platform threshold - fastest credible revenue

ideas.name: Ambient/lofi long-form streams
monetization_paths: TV watch time (1B+ hours/day on TV)
